headers.name: actual_boundary_displayedPair_iff
headers.header:
theorem actual_boundary_displayedPair_iff (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (hm : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawQuartetMean q=distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        (coordinateQuartet (fun i => (rank (q i)).val))))
    (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (nonadj : i.val+1<j.val ∧ ¬(i.val=0 ∧ j.val+1=n)) :
    displayedPair (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      ((i.val+1)%n) j.val i.val ((j.val+1)%n)=true ↔
      ({rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val,Finset.univ \ rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val} :
        Finset (Finset X)) ∈ actualDisplayedSplits N Finset.univ

    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)

    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (hmean : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawQuartetMean q=distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        (coordinateQuartet (fun i => (rank (q i)).val))))
    (m : X → ℚ) (hm : ∀ x, 0<m x) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (nonadj : i.val+1<j.val ∧ ¬(i.val=0 ∧ j.val+1=n)) :
    0<circularAlpha (fun x y => N.actualWeightedAnchorDistance m (rank.symm x) (rank.symm y)) i j ↔
      ({rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val,Finset.univ \ rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val} :
        Finset (Finset X)) ∈ actualDisplayedSplits N Finset.univ

headers.name: actual_boundary_resolution_whole_cut
headers.header:
theorem actual_boundary_resolution_whole_cut (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (i j : Nat) (hij : i<j) (hjn : j<n)
    (q : Fin 4 ↪ X)
    (h0 : (rank (q 0)).val=i+1) (h1 : (rank (q 1)).val=j)
    (h2 : (rank (q 2)).val=i)
    (h3 : (rank (q 3)).val=if j+1=n then 0 else j+1)
    (hq : Resolution.xy_zw ∈ N.rawDisplayedQuartets q) :
    ∃ S : N.Switching, ∃ e : S.Edge,
      ((∀ x : X, S.graph.DReach (S.graph.target e) (N.leaf x) ↔
          i<(rank x).val ∧ (rank x).val≤j) ∨
       (∀ x : X, ¬S.graph.DReach (S.graph.target e) (N.leaf x) ↔
          i<(rank x).val ∧ (rank x).val≤j))

          i<a.val ∧ a.val≤j) ∨

headers.name: actual_weighted_all_interval_support
headers.header:
theorem actual_weighted_all_interval_support (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (hmean : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawQuartetMean q=distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        (coordinateQuartet (fun i => (rank (q i)).val))))
    (m : X → ℚ) (hm : ∀ x, 0<m x) :
    CircularDecomposable (fun x y => N.actualWeightedAnchorDistance m (rank.symm x) (rank.symm y)) ∧
    (∀ i j : Fin n, i<j →
      (0<circularAlpha (fun x y => N.actualWeightedAnchorDistance m (rank.symm x) (rank.symm y)) i j ↔
        ({rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val,Finset.univ \ rankIntervalSide rank i.val j.val} :
          Finset (Finset X)) ∈ actualDisplayedSplits N Finset.univ)) ∧
    (∀ cut∈actualDisplayedSplits N Finset.univ, ∃ i j : Nat, i<j ∧ j<n ∧
      cut={rankIntervalSide rank i j,Finset.univ \ rankIntervalSide rank i j})

headers.name: actual_ranked_anchor_entry

theorem actual_ranked_anchor_entry (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hm : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawQuartetMean q=distinctMean (finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        (coordinateQuartet (fun i => (rank (q i)).val))))
    (x y p q : Fin n) :
    N.actualTupleAnchor ![rank.symm x,rank.symm y,rank.symm p,rank.symm q] =

theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_diagonal (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (x : Fin n) : finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m x x=0

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_alpha
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_alpha (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (i j : Fin n) :
    circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j =
      ∑ pq ∈ upperPairs n, m pq.1*m pq.2 *
        (alpha n (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
          pq.1.val pq.2.val i.val j.val : ℚ)

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_alpha_nonnegative
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_alpha_nonnegative (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (hm : ∀ p, 0≤m p) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j) :
    0≤circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_absent_zero
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_absent_zero (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (nonadj : i.val+1<j.val ∧ ¬(i.val=0 ∧ j.val+1=n))
    (absent : displayedPair (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      ((i.val+1)%n) j.val i.val ((j.val+1)%n)=false) :
    circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j=0

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_positive_anchor
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_positive_anchor (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (hm : ∀ p, 0<m p) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (p q : Fin n) (hpq : p≠q)
    (ha : 0<alpha n (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
      p.val q.val i.val j.val) :
    0<circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_nontrivial_support
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_nontrivial_support (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (hm : ∀ p, 0<m p) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (nonadj : i.val+1<j.val ∧ ¬(i.val=0 ∧ j.val+1=n)) :
    0<circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j ↔
      displayedPair (quartets n) (codedPattern T (occurrenceLabels n mask) n)
        ((i.val+1)%n) j.val i.val ((j.val+1)%n)=true

headers.name: finiteWeightedMatrix_pendant_positive
headers.header:
theorem finiteWeightedMatrix_pendant_positive (n mask : Nat) (T : Tree)
    (hn : 3≤n) (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (m : Fin n → ℚ) (hm : ∀ p, 0<m p) (i j : Fin n) (hij : i<j)
    (hadj : j=cyclicNext i ∨ i=cyclicNext j) :
    0<circularAlpha (finiteWeightedMatrix n mask T m) i j

headers.name: actual_ranked_cut_no_hole
headers.header:
theorem actual_ranked_cut_no_hole (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (S : N.Switching) (e : S.Edge) (A : Finset Nat)
    (hbound : ∀ a ∈ A, a<n) (hz : 0 ∉ A)
    (horient :
      (∀ a : Fin n, a.val ∈ A ↔ S.graph.DReach (S.graph.target e) (N.leaf (rank.symm a))) ∨
      (∀ a : Fin n, a.val ∈ A ↔ ¬S.graph.DReach (S.graph.target e) (N.leaf (rank.symm a)))) :
    ∀ x y z : Nat, x ∈ A → z ∈ A → x≤y → y≤z → y∈A

headers.name: actual_sorted_crossing_absent
headers.header:
theorem actual_sorted_crossing_absent (N : RootedBinary V E X)
    (n mask : Nat) (rank : X ≃ Fin n) (T : Tree)
    (hs : T.size=(occurrenceLabels n mask).length-1)
    (hsets : ∀ q : Fin 4 ↪ X,
      N.rawDisplayedQuartets q=finiteResolutionSet T (occurrenceLabels n mask)
        ⟨(rank (q 0)).val,(rank (q 1)).val,(rank (q 2)).val,(rank (q 3)).val⟩)
    (q : Fin 4 ↪ X)
    (h01 : (rank (q 0)).val<(rank (q 1)).val)
    (h12 : (rank (q 1)).val<(rank (q 2)).val)
    (h23 : (rank (q 2)).val<(rank (q 3)).val) :
    Resolution.xz_yw ∉ N.rawDisplayedQuartets q
